entries.title: The catalogue opens
entries.body:
Forty-five free blueprints are available, covering FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis,
Docker, GitHub Actions, vector search, streaming, MCP and LLM agents.

Every blueprint is one self-contained document. It states when to use the
architecture and when not to, gives the reference implementation, the rules that
matter and the failure modes, and ends with a definition of done. You can hand a
single file to an AI coding agent and it has everything it needs — nothing points
elsewhere for something you need.

Each one is written to be applied to a project that already exists. The agent is
told to audit what is there before it proposes anything, and never to replace
working code without asking you first.
